summary: Competition check 2026-10-09 for AS01: 31 market actors recorded (6 competitors, 12 alternatives); details list what each does, its traction signal, licence and the gap versus the candidate. Source files: R1-orchestration.md, R2-routing.md under docs/inquiry/agentic-stack-2026-10-09/research/.
details:
- Paperclip [partner]: Self-hosted control plane for agent companies: org charts, issues, budgets, approvals, routines, CLI adapters with subscription sign-in; alpha plugin SDK Gap/note: Host platform; per-agent model/effort exists, no learned routing or documented per-run model hook upstream Traction: 99.1k GitHub stars, 16.7k forks (https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Model Capacity plugin (TogetherWeOwn) [competitor]: Paperclip plugin choosing model and effort per run from Artificial Analysis data and live CLIProxy quota; shadow-only by default; enforcement via fork hook run.model.resolve Gap/note: Same job, deterministic benchmark-driven rather than learned from own outcomes Traction: 0 GitHub stars (https://github.com/TogetherWeOwn/paperclip-plugin-model-capacity). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Tutti [alternative]: CLI orchestrating Claude Code, Codex, Aider, OpenClaw in tmux/worktrees with tutti.toml workflows, cron, checkpoints and handoff packets Gap/note: No model/effort or learned routing Traction: 131 GitHub stars (https://github.com/nutthouse/tutti). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Hydra [competitor]: Multi-agent orchestrator routing across Claude, Gemini, Codex CLIs with affinity routing claimed to learn from outcomes Gap/note: Claims outcome-learned routing (vendor claim, no evidence) Traction: 3 GitHub stars (krowxx fork also 3) (https://github.com/mikecubed/Hydra). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Claude Code routines (Anthropic) [benchmark]: Cloud Claude Code sessions triggered by schedule, API or GitHub events; research preview; draws subscription usage Gap/note: Fixed model per routine Traction: First-party on Pro/Max/Team/Enterprise (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/routines). Licence: Proprietary (included in plans). Checked 2026-10-09.
- Codex scheduled tasks (OpenAI) [benchmark]: Recurring Codex tasks in app/web with selectable model and reasoning effort; local tasks need the app running Gap/note: Manual model/effort choice Traction: First-party on Plus/Pro/Business/Enterprise (https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/pricing). Licence: Proprietary (included in plans). Checked 2026-10-09.
- OpenCode [partner]: Open-source coding agent; supports ChatGPT Plus/Pro login; removed Claude Pro/Max plugins citing Anthropic prohibition Gap/note: Worker runtime incl. local models Traction: 212.3k GitHub stars (https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- OpenClaw [benchmark]: Personal assistant gateway with cron jobs and two-stage failover (auth-profile rotation, model fallbacks) incl. Codex OAuth profiles Gap/note: Static fallback order Traction: 391.5k GitHub stars (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Ruflo (claude-flow) [competitor]: Meta-harness for Claude Code and Codex with swarms, memory, loop workers; claims intelligent routing and provider failover (vendor claims) Gap/note: Claims 89% routing accuracy, unverified Traction: 74.2k GitHub stars (https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- CLIProxyAPI [partner]: Proxy exposing CLI OAuth logins as OpenAI/Claude-compatible APIs with multi-account round-robin Gap/note: Quota telemetry source used by Model Capacity Traction: 54.6k GitHub stars (https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- claude-code-router [alternative]: Local control plane routing agent requests across models with rule conditions, retries and ordered fallbacks Gap/note: Static rules, not learned Traction: 37.6k GitHub stars (https://github.com/musistudio/claude-code-router). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Mastra [benchmark]: TypeScript agent/workflow framework with 40+ providers and suspend/resume Gap/note: Provider abstraction Traction: 28.7k GitHub stars (https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra). Licence: Apache-2.0 plus Mastra Enterprise License for ee/. Checked 2026-10-09.
- LiteLLM [competitor]: OSS gateway with fallbacks/cooldowns/budgets; Auto Router v2 with complexity tiers, effort ladders, Thompson-sampled adaptive pools, Claude Code/Codex harness-aware routing Gap/note: Bandit pools + effort ladders + stall escalation; reward signal undocumented Traction: 60.5k GitHub stars (https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm). Licence: Open core + LiteLLM Commercial License for enterprise. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Not Diamond (Not Diamond Code, Prompt Optimization) [competitor]: Hosted router; Code routes model+reasoning effort per coding-agent step, cache-aware, adapts to implicit developer feedback (vendor claim); Prompt Optimization adapts prompts per target model Gap/note: Closest direct overlap; early access, closed Traction: ~$2.3M total funding; IBM, SAP.iO investors (https://www.caplight.com/company/not-diamond). Licence: Proprietary hosted. Checked 2026-10-09.
- OpenRouter Auto Router [alternative]: Task-type classifier + trailing-7-day spend-share ranking within cost tier; no router fee Gap/note: Community-data routing, not per-user outcomes Traction: Stripe agreed to acquire (2026-08-19); 10M users per investor (https://menlovc.com/perspective/stripe-to-acquire-openrouter-why-everyone-is-obsessed-with-model-routing/). Licence: Proprietary hosted. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Mastra ModelSelectionProcessor [alternative]: Classifier-backed per-run model selection with fallback to configured models (@mastra/core 1.70.0, 2026-09-24) Gap/note: Static classifier, no outcome learning Traction: 28.7k GitHub stars (framework) (https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra). Licence: Apache-2.0 core; ee/ source-available. Checked 2026-10-09.
- RouteLLM [benchmark]: Preference-trained strong/weak routers; last commit 2024-08-10 Gap/note: Offline baseline Traction: 5.6k GitHub stars (https://github.com/lm-sys/RouteLLM). Licence: Apache-2.0. Checked 2026-10-09.
- LLMRouter (UIUC) / BaRP [benchmark]: Research library of 16+ routers and xRouteBench; BaRP learns routing from bandit feedback Gap/note: Algorithms and benchmark for outcome-learned routing Traction: Research (https://arxiv.org/pdf/2510.07429). Licence: Open source (research). Checked 2026-10-09.
- TensorZero [benchmark]: LLMOps gateway with feedback/experimentation loop; archived 2026-06-12, company wound down Gap/note: Cautionary: OSS feedback-loop gateway failed commercial fit Traction: 11.7k GitHub stars; archived (https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48518120). Licence: Apache-2.0 (unmaintained). Checked 2026-10-09.
- Requesty [alternative]: Hosted gateway with task-label classifier and policy-based routing/fallbacks (vendor) Gap/note: Offline classifier Traction: n/a (https://www.requesty.ai/blog/smarter-than-human-model-picking-introducing-requesty-smart-routing). Licence: Proprietary hosted. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Martian [benchmark]: Early LLM router; homepage now centers interpretability and ARES online RL for coding agents Gap/note: Router company apparently de-emphasizing routing Traction: $9M led by NEA; Accenture investment (2024) (https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20240917605865/en/Accenture-Invests-in-Martian-to-Bring-Dynamic-Routing-of-Large-Language-Queries-and-More-Effective-AI-Systems-to-Clients). Licence: Proprietary. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Unify [benchmark]: Former LLM router; now continual RL post-training of production agents Gap/note: Router startup pivot signal Traction: n/a (https://unify.ai). Licence: Proprietary hosted. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Plano (katanemo, formerly Arch) [alternative]: Agent data plane with preference-aligned routing via 4B routing model Gap/note: Preference routing, no documented outcome learning Traction: 7.1k GitHub stars (https://github.com/katanemo/plano). Licence: Apache-2.0. Checked 2026-10-09.
- vLLM Semantic Router [competitor]: Signal/DSL routing; v0.4 Hermes with optional off-by-default outcome gate; session and provider-state portability checks Gap/note: OSS, partial; improvement loop offline Traction: 6.1k GitHub stars (https://github.com/vllm-project/semantic-router). Licence: Apache-2.0. Checked 2026-10-09.
- semantic-router (Aurelio) [partner]: Embedding-similarity routing library Gap/note: Building block Traction: 3.9k GitHub stars (https://github.com/aurelio-labs/semantic-router). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Azure Foundry Model Router [alternative]: Trained ML router with Balanced/Cost/Quality modes, failover, session affinity Gap/note: No customer-outcome learning Traction: n/a (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/foundry/openai/concepts/model-router-how-it-works). Licence: Azure service. Checked 2026-10-09.
- AWS Bedrock Intelligent Prompt Routing [alternative]: Predicts response quality within a model family; cannot adapt to app-specific performance data Gap/note: Static offline router Traction: n/a (https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/prompt-routing.html). Licence: AWS service. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Vertex AI Model Optimizer [alternative]: Gemini-only meta-endpoint routing by cost/quality preference Gap/note: Single-vendor Traction: n/a (https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/model-reference/vertex-ai-model-optimizer). Licence: GCP service. Checked 2026-10-09.
- In-harness routers (Cursor Router, Copilot Auto, Augment Prism, Factory Router) [alternative]: Per-request/turn/session routing bundled inside vendor coding agents Gap/note: Bundled, harness-locked Traction: Vendor claims 20-60% savings (https://github.blog/changelog/2026-05-20-auto-model-selection-now-routes-based-on-your-task-in-vs-code). Licence: Proprietary, bundled. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Claude Code built-in model controls [alternative]: fallbackModel on overload (not rate limits), opusplan, per-model effort levels, adaptive reasoning Gap/note: Native effort/model baseline Traction: n/a (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config). Licence: Proprietary. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Ramp Router / TrustedRouter [alternative]: New 2026 API routers (strategy/benchmark-based; open verifiable router) G
